defmodule FirmwareOTA.TenantRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Multi-tenant device registry with shared resource pool"
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:tenant_id, :devices, :resource_handle, :generation]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: via_tuple(opts[:tenant_id]))
  end

  def init(opts) do
    tenant_id = opts[:tenant_id]
    handle = NativeResourcePool.acquire(tenant_id)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{tenant_id: tenant_id, devices: %{}, resource_handle: handle, generation: 0}}
  end

  defp via_tuple(tenant_id), do: {:via, Registry, {FirmwareOTA.Registry, tenant_id}}

  def register_device(tenant_id, device_id, firmware_ref) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:register, device_id, firmware_ref})
  end

  def rotate_resources(tenant_id) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), :rotate)
  end

  def get_device_context(tenant_id, device_id) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:get_context, device_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:register, device_id, firmware_ref}, _from, state) do
    device_entry = %{
      firmware_ref: firmware_ref,
      registered_at: System.monotonic_time(),
      resource_handle: state.resource_handle,
      generation: state.generation
    }
    new_devices = Map.put(state.devices, device_id, device_entry)
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | devices: new_devices}}
  end

  def handle_call(:rotate, _from, state) do
    old_handle = state.resource_handle
    new_handle = NativeResourcePool.acquire(state.tenant_id)
    # Schedule deferred release to allow in-flight operations to complete
    schedule_deferred_release(old_handle, state.generation)
    # Update all existing device entries to use new handle
    new_devices = state.devices
      |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> {k, %{v | resource_handle: new_handle, generation: state.generation + 1}} end)
      |> Map.new()
    new_state = %{state | resource_handle: new_handle, generation: state.generation + 1, devices: new_devices}
    {:reply, :ok, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:get_context, device_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.devices, device_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      device_entry ->
        # Return context using the device's stored handle reference
        context = build_device_context(device_entry)
        {:reply, {:ok, context}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:deferred_release, handle, _generation}, state) do
    NativeResourcePool.release(handle)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp schedule_deferred_release(handle, generation) do
    Process.send_after(self(), {:deferred_release, handle, generation}, 50)
  end

  defp build_device_context(device_entry) do
    # Uses the resource_handle stored at registration time
    # After rotation, device entries are updated so handle is always valid
    %{
      firmware_ref: device_entry.firmware_ref,
      resource_ptr: NativeResourcePool.dereference(device_entry.resource_handle),
      generation: device_entry.generation
    }
  end
end

defmodule NativeResourcePool do
  @moduledoc "NIF-backed resource pool for hardware abstraction layer"

  def acquire(tenant_id) do
    # Returns an opaque reference to a native resource
    # In real firmware, this is a NIF that allocates DMA buffers
    ref = make_ref()
    :ets.insert(:resource_pool, {ref, tenant_id, :active, :erlang.monotonic_time()})
    ref
  end

  def release(handle) do
    case :ets.lookup(:resource_pool, handle) do
      [{^handle, _tenant, :active, _ts}] ->
        :ets.update_element(:resource_pool, handle, {3, :freed})
        # In real firmware: nif_free_dma_buffer(handle)
        :ok
      _ ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  def dereference(handle) do
    case :ets.lookup(:resource_pool, handle) do
      [{^handle, tenant, :active, _ts}] ->
        # Safe: only returns data if resource is still active
        {handle, tenant}
      [{^handle, _tenant, :freed, _ts}] ->
        nil
      [] ->
        nil
    end
  end
end

defmodule FirmwareOTA.UpdateCoordinator do
  @moduledoc "Coordinates firmware updates across tenant boundaries"

  def apply_update(tenant_id, device_id, new_firmware) do
    # Step 1: Rotate resources (invalidates old handles after delay)
    FirmwareOTA.TenantRegistry.rotate_resources(tenant_id)

    # Step 2: Small delay simulating firmware verification
    Process.sleep(100)

    # Step 3: Access device context - device entries were updated during rotation
    # so they always reference the current valid handle
    case FirmwareOTA.TenantRegistry.get_device_context(tenant_id, device_id) do
      {:ok, context} ->
        # context.resource_ptr is always from a valid, active handle
        perform_dma_transfer(context, new_firmware)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp perform_dma_transfer(context, firmware_data) do
    # Safe: resource_ptr is guaranteed to reference active memory
    {:ok, %{context: context, written: byte_size(firmware_data)}}
  end
end
